missing.why: Rappel makes her untargetable, which players remember as 'vanishing'. The term excludes untargetable, so rule-correct out.
Death Mark makes him untargetable and players think of shadows as stealth. Rule-correct out.
Players remember him hiding as an effigy and lurking unseen, but no ability makes him Invisible or Camouflaged. Rule-correct out.

disputable.why: Her invisibility is only the 1-second passive at low health; players remember the Mirror Image, not the stealth.
Shapesplitter's invisibility is brief and players think of Neeko as a disguise champion, which the term doesn't count.
Only her grass-enchanted Q trail makes her Invisible; players may not remember it.
Harrowed Path's Camouflage is real, but players think of his possession, which isn't invisibility.

wording.why: The Prompt says 'invisible' but the Rule also counts Camouflage (Pyke, Akshan, Viego, Senna). Players who know the difference may hold back those answers.
wording.suggestion: Name a champion who can become invisible or camouflaged

aliases.why: Universal nickname for the Plague Rat.

fun.why: Twitch, Evelynn, Shaco and Teemo come instantly, then a tail of camouflage and conditional stealth (Pyke, Senna, Viego, Kai'Sa's evolved E) that few players get all of.

champion:Twitch.why: Ambush is the textbook stealth; many players' first answer.

champion:Teemo.why: Guerrilla Warfare in brush is famous and infamous.

champion:Akali.why: Twilight Shroud is one of the best-known stealth tools.

champion:Khazix.why: Void Assault stealth is well known.

champion:Vayne.why: Tumble during Final Hour is classic ADC stealth.

champion:Rengar.why: Thrill of the Hunt is memorable from being jumped on.

champion:Talon.why: Shadow Assault stealth is known by assassin players.

champion:MonkeyKing.why: Warrior Trickster's decoy-and-stealth is well known.

champion:Kaisa.why: Evolved Supercharge stealth is known to ADC players, forgotten by others.

champion:Pyke.why: Ghostwater Dive is camouflage; support players get it.

champion:Akshan.why: Going Rogue camouflage; Akshan is less played.

champion:Leblanc.why: Passive stealth is brief; mid players remember it.

champion:Senna.why: Curse of the Black Mist camouflage is known to her players.

champion:Qiyana.why: The grass Q trail is a detail few remember.

champion:Viego.why: Harrowed Path camouflage is overshadowed by possession.

champion:Aurora.why: Newer champion; her W invisibility is little known.

gemCandidates.why: Ghostwater Dive is the 'oh, of course' camouflage once revealed; support players actually get it.
Her evolved E is a real stealth tool many forget; very satisfying for ADC players.
Going Rogue is a signature camouflage that's easy to miss under his revive.
